units.source_text: 我依然一声不吭，心理暗想，刚才那么欺负我，现在难道又想做什么吗？

en.t: I still said nothing, thinking to myself, after bullying me like that just now, what could he possibly want to do now?

units.source_text: 但是，哥哥一点也不介意，继续说：“

en.t: But my brother did not mind at all and went on saying, "

units.source_text: 爸爸之所以不让你看雏人偶，不仅仅是因为收下了人家的定金。

en.t: The reason Father will not let you look at the hina dolls is not only that he has already taken a deposit from the buyer.

units.source_text: 也是担心越看越舍不得——你也要替爸爸考虑一下，行吗？

en.t: He is also worried that the more he looks at them, the harder it will be to part with them, so please think about Father a little too, all right?
Do you understand? Do you understand?

units.source_text: 不要跟刚才一样吵着要再看一眼了。”

en.t: Do not fuss again like you did just now, saying you want to see them one more time."
